groups.label: Claude Opus 5
groups.note: Reconstruction comparisons with Claude Opus 5. VIGA uses the paper's object-grouping instructions. Source cameras are estimated independently; REST3D uses an approximately recovered camera. Nearby views rotate each method's source camera by +30° in its own scene frame. REST3D and SimFoundry show the qualitative visualization variants with white support surfaces.

methods.label: REST3D
methods.note: Approximately recovered source camera; white support-surface visualization variant.

methods.label: VIGA
methods.note: Object-grouped Claude Opus 5 run used in the paper.

groups.label: GPT-6 Astra
groups.note: These qualitative views show reconstructions before the additional post-reconstruction stability test; the paper’s quantitative GPT-6 comparison scores VIGA and direct Codex after five seconds of PhysX settling. SceneRig uses GPT-6 reconstruction agents with Claude Opus 5 preprocessing and includes its own physics refinement. VIGA uses object grouping and medium reasoning; direct Codex uses ultra reasoning. Nearby views are relative +30° camera changes in each reconstructed scene, rather than identical ground-truth camera poses.
